_comment_optional: Keys above are the minimal required set. The keys below are common OPTIONAL overrides (node type, compute/cluster policy, serverless budget policy, alternate app name). JSON has no comments, so the _comment_* keys are documentation only -- DAB ignores unknown top-level keys, but delete them if your tooling is strict. Delete any optional key you do not need. For the FULL advanced set (run_as SP, OBO user_api_scopes, app_permissions, Lakebase) copy variable-overrides.advanced.example.json instead.
_comment_node_type: Job-cluster node type -- must match your cloud. AWS i3.2xlarge (default); Azure Standard_DS4_v2; GCP n2-highmem-8.
_comment_cluster_policy: COMPUTE/CLUSTER POLICY: override the WHOLE metadata_job_cluster block (a bare policy_id string is NOT supported -- the v1.8.0+ direct deploy engine rejects an empty policy_id). Copy the default from variables.yml and add policy_id + apply_policy_default_values. lakebase_job_cluster is the same pattern for the graph->Lakebase sync job. OMIT this whole block for a policy-free deploy (the default).
_comment_budget_policy: Serverless budget policy ID for cost attribution on serverless jobs (Settings > Compute > Serverless usage policies). Plain string; empty (default) IS accepted at job level (unlike cluster policy_id).
_comment_app_name: Alternate app name. app_name_suffix appends to BOTH the app display name and the job-name prefix, so multiple instances can coexist in one workspace (the app is a singleton by name). e.g. "-dev". Honored by grant_app_permissions.sh too.
